tasks.title: Triage the oldest open bug
tasks.goal: In acme/api, list the open issues labeled "bug" (oldest first), read the oldest one, and ask the reporter for logs and the Redis version in a comment.

steps.command: via github issue:list --owner acme --repo api --state OPEN --labels bug --order-by CREATED_AT --direction ASC --per-page 10
via github issue:read --method get --owner acme --repo api --issue-number 214

via github issue-comment:add --owner acme --repo api --issue-number 214 --body "Thanks for the report. Could you attach the server log around the failing request and say which Redis version you run? That will tell us whether the limiter should fail open or closed."
mcp2cli @github list-issues --owner acme --repo api --state OPEN --labels '["bug"]' --order-by CREATED_AT --direction ASC --per-page 10

mcp2cli @github add-issue-comment --owner acme --repo api --issue-number 214 --body "Thanks for the report. Could you attach the server log around the failing request and say which Redis version you run? That will tell us whether the limiter should fail open or closed."
mcpc @github tools-call list_issues owner:=acme repo:=api state:=OPEN labels:='["bug"]' orderBy:=CREATED_AT direction:=ASC perPage:=10
mcpc @github tools-call issue_read method:=get owner:=acme repo:=api issue_number:=214

mcpc @github tools-call add_issue_comment owner:=acme repo:=api issue_number:=214 body:="Thanks for the report. Could you attach the server log around the failing request and say which Redis version you run? That will tell us whether the limiter should fail open or closed."

tasks.title: File a bug in a team
tasks.goal: File a high-priority bug in the Platform team's Linear, assigned to me, about the rate limiter failing closed when Redis is down.

steps.command: via linear issue:create --title "Rate limiter fails closed when Redis is down" --team Platform --description "Every request returns 500 while Redis is unreachable. The limiter should fail open and log a warning." --priority 2 --assignee me --labels Bug

tasks.title: List DNS records of a zone
tasks.goal: List the DNS records of the acme.test zone in the Acme Production Cloudflare account.

steps.command: via cloudflare search --code "return Object.entries(spec.paths).filter(([p]) => p.includes('dns_records')).map(([p, v]) => ({ path: p, methods: Object.keys(v) }))"

via cloudflare execute --account-id 023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353 --code "const zones = await cloudflare.zones.list({ name: 'acme.test' }); return await cloudflare.dns.records.list({ zone_id: zones.result[0].id });"
